node.statement: All nonassociative axioms with explicit errors: at each matrix level let T=I_Mn tensor Phi and P=I_Mn tensor tilde-Phi, so ||P-T||<=r and ||P||<=M. The range of P is a closed complete self-adjoint operator space; P(I)=I, P is star-preserving, and P^2=P. Hence X star Y=P(XY) is bilinear and range-valued, I is an exact unit, and (X star Y)^*=Y^* star X^*. Also ||X star Y||<=M||X||||Y||, giving submultiplicativity error r. For X in Im(P), ||T(X)||>=||X||-r||X||=(1-r)||X||; UCP Schwarz gives ||T(X^*X)||>=||T(X)||^2, and therefore ||P(X^*X)||>=||T(X^*X)||-r||X||^2>=(1-3r+r^2)||X||^2. Thus the C-star lower-norm error is 3r-r^2 for small r.
